claim: If you create an SQS delay queue, messages that you send to the queue remain invisible to consumers for the delay period; the default (minimum) delay for a queue is 0 seconds and the maximum is 15 minutes.

evidence.quote: If you create a delay queue, any messages that you send to the queue remain invisible to consumers for the duration of the delay period. The default (minimum) delay for a queue is 0 seconds. The maximum is 15 minutes.
